title: NICE BUT HAVE CHEAP ZIPPERS
text: NICE BUT HAVE CHEAP ZIPPERS. iThese pillow covers are nice and soft but I don't think they will hold up over time. The zippers are made of thin plastic and without care they will come apart. My covers had thread hanging from the seams. I think they would be nice were it not for the shoddy zippers.

product_metadata.title: SET OF 2 NEW ZIPPERED QUILTED PILLOW COVERS - STANDARD SIZE
description: Quilted Set of 2 Bed Pillow Protectors with Zippers. Face fabric is a thick polyester/cotton blend for extra comfort. The backing and fiberfill is 100% polyester. This protector keeps your pillow clean and sanitary. Rustproof zipper allows for easy removal. Recover and protect your pillows (bed pillows NOT included) Add to your sleeping comfort Machine Washable.
